maria: Quick syncplanning v2.3.0 roll tomorrow 10:00 PT. Model pin + batching opt + tiny RN telemetry tweak. Need ops standby and explicit rollback gate.
pm-jordan: Draft RN below. Please pin to eng and staging channels. I want a T-60 reminder. :thumbsup: 
maria: Draft RN (internal):
```
v2.3.0 internal
- Model pinned: redwood-quant-v2
- Perf: smarter batching for short-context (~10-20% token cost drop)
- Fix: kv-cache eviction under high concurrency
- Obs: per-route token breakdown in Console
Rollout: canary 10% 30m -> 40% 30m -> 100% if metrics OK
Immediate rollback if: error rate >2%, tail latency >2x baseline >5m, token cost +30%, security alert
```
emily-qa: I'll run smoke at T-30: short/long prompts, streaming, tool calls. Will post results here.
sre-alex: I'll be primary 09:30-12:30 PT, devon backup?
devon: Yup 09:30-13:30 backup. Will join if paged. :ok_hand: 
deploy-bot: Scheduled 2026-03-22T10:00:00-07:00. Command queued: `deploy --version v2.3.0 --pin redwood-quant-v2`
opsbot: Reminder: run staging preheat: `./scripts/warm_kv_cache.sh --routes=chat,generation`
sre-alex: I'll pin dashboards (error rate, p50/p95, token-cost) and post links T-5.
maria: Who will send internal announce at T-60?
pm-jordan: maria please send. Use one-liner: "Heads-up: v2.3.0 rolling tomorrow 10:00 PT. Minimal user risk; ops standby in place."
devon: Keep v2.2.1 hot for pinback. Ops confirm pinback within 2min?
opsbot: Confirmed. `ops pin-model --customer=global --version=v2.2.1` available from deploy console.
emily-qa: If sampling quality regresses >5% we block and post diffs.
maria: Final checklist:
- [x] RN approved
- [x] QA smoke ready
- [x] Oncall + backup assigned
- [ ] Deploybot confirm
- [ ] Internal announce T-1h
- [ ] Dashboards pinned
- [ ] Preheat staging cache
deploy-bot: Canary schedule locked; will post canary start/finish timestamps to thread when triggered.
maria: I'll send the T-1h announce and paste RN here. Update in thread if anything changes. :raised_hands:
